Voice Samples

Same reference voice throughout. A: words rewritten to be spoken. A+: A plus Turbo's emotion tags ([happy], [surprised], [chuckle], [sigh]) and real pauses. B: the original (non-Turbo) Chatterbox with its expressiveness dial at 0.8. B+: B plus sound tags ([giggle], [gasp], [sigh]) and dash pauses, at 0.8 and at the maximum 1.0.

Teddy · Grades 3–5

Now

You could count every cookie.

A · words

Hmm… you could count every single cookie, one by one.

A+ · words + emotion tags

[chuckle] Hmm... you could count every single cookie, one by one.

B · original Chatterbox, expressive 0.8

Hmm... you could count every single cookie, one by one.

B+ · B + sound tags + pauses, 0.8

[giggle] Hmm — you could count every single cookie, one by one.

B+ · same, pushed to 1.0

[giggle] Hmm — you could count every single cookie, one by one.
